title: Provision CodeGraph indexes for isolated VIXEN worktrees
body: The mandated first codegraph explore query could not run because this isolated worktree had no .codegraph index. The lane then had to fall back to rg and manual source tracing; provision or expose a read-only index as part of worktree setup.

title: Make VIXEN discover its paired Undertow root
body: The documented configure and every queued witness failed when UNDERTOW_ROOT was unset. The lane had to create a clean detached Undertow pair and export its absolute path manually; consolidate paired-root discovery and validation into the VIXEN workflow.

title: Make build-wsl.sh accept configure definitions safely
body: The supported command ./build-wsl.sh -DVIXEN_WITH_FSR3=OFF reconfigured successfully but then forwarded the -D argument to cmake --build and failed with Unknown argument. The lane had to split configure and build manually; make the wrapper accept configure variables or reject them with a correct command.

title: Key VIXEN runtime shader caches by shader source
body: After editing SpatialReuseShade.comp, the witness reused stale SPIR-V until the lane manually deleted every file under its local build/wsl/runtime-cache. The renderer build should invalidate or fingerprint runtime shader caches from source content automatically.

title: Expose one hazard-aware scene-radiance producer seam
body: The HDR fix needed a manual conditional split: the top-level graph could connect a scene-radiance gatherer only when reconstruction inputs were absent, while ReconstructionHistoryModule had to be edited to gather both previous and current images without double-driving SpatialReuse IMAGE_WRITE_ARRAY. Consolidate this shared producer hazard contract so graph variants cannot duplicate or omit the sync edge.

title: Make translated-GPU witness recovery deterministic
body: Two fresh queued HDR-on attempts hit VK_ERROR_DEVICE_LOST during translated Dozen command recording and the documented VIXEN_RECOVER_TRANSLATED_DEVICE=1 retry still segfaulted; a later clean retry passed. Provide a bounded, lane-safe GPU reset/recovery path so witnesses do not depend on transient device state.

title: Make direct Cornell capture witnesses self-provisioning
body: A direct queued test invocation used to override VIXEN_HDR_EXPOSURE failed because the binary requires CMake to inject VIXEN_HEADLESS_CORNELL_CAPTURE_PREFIX. The lane had to copy that environment manually; provide a wrapper/default capture path so HDR-on/off direct witnesses cannot fail on setup.
